column1: # Points of the graph of the full performance statistics, with the first line of the message that wasm/wasmplayer.cpp
# then sends to the front end. Both sides read this file: FormatFullStatsMessage() in wasm/compact_stats.hpp
# (tests/native/compact_stats_test.cpp) writes the line, and parseFullStatsMessage() in wasm/platform/messages.js
# (tests/unit/stats-graph.test.js) reads the point back from it, so the two stay the same.
# Format, separated by tabs: RTT in ms (0 while unknown), frames lost on the network in the window, the first line of the
# message, the RTT that the front end reads (empty for unknown), the frames lost that it reads.
